name: Loli Kyonyuu Hitozuma Nakadashi Kaigo ~Otou-san, Ramee! Sonna ni Tsukaretara Ano Hito no Toko ni Modorenaku Nacchau~
original_name: ロリ巨乳人妻中出し介護 ～お義父さん、らめぇ！そんなに突かれたらあの人のとこに戻れなくなっちゃうっ～
source:
A father let his son move home during a time of crisis.
It wasn't because he was charitable; he really wanted to f*ck his son's wife!
A life under one roof means she has to care for him and be harassed,
but it's too much. What if she gets pregnant? What will she do then!?

Poor son is a cuckold with no clue... his wife is making a family with his father!

translation:
一位父亲在危机时刻让儿子搬回家。
这并不是因为他乐善好施；而是因为他热心慈善。他真的很想操他儿子的妻子！
同住一个屋檐下，她要照顾他，还要受骚扰，
但这太多了。如果她怀孕了怎么办？到时候她要做什么！？

可怜的儿子戴了绿帽子，毫无头绪……他的妻子正在和他的父亲组建家庭！
